name: A confined coordinator command carries one attachment, and the token must name it
aliases: one attachment for a coordinator command
the token names the attachment that is used
a directory at ONBOARDING.md is a refusal
summary: A confined coordinator command carries one local file as a single @attachment:N token, with the flag kept on the attachment (the older two-token --file form is still accepted for a hand-built request); the token names the attachment that is used, and a token naming an attachment that is not there is refused, never answered by falling back to another attachment. On set-onboarding a directory at ONBOARDING.md is refused before anything is written, as a sentence with rc 2, instead of reaching os.replace inside the guarded write where the OSError is not a refusal and the answer was rc 124 'outcome unknown' with the identity reserved. A payload operation the route does not name (draft) is refused on the payload, single or beside items, before any library is called.
